description: Non-rendered capability scope records. These describe documentation work that is defined but deliberately not yet written, and the conditions under which a record must convert into published disclosure. Nothing here is published to the documentation site.

records.rationale: Originally scope-only on the expectation of an imminent fix. Converted to disclose-now because the defect is still present, disclosures now exist, and a scope-only record cannot block publication. The detailed dynamic-model documentation remains deferred; only the defect is disclosed.
defect_summary: M_ij is built from the product of separately test-filtered quantities rather than the test filter of the product |S|S_ij, and uses filter(|S|) where |filter(S)| is required. Both terms therefore share an identical factor and M_ij collapses to -2*Delta^2*(alpha-1)*filter(|S|)*filter(S_ij).

Because M_ij reduces to a fixed scalar multiple of the filtered strain-rate tensor, alpha cancels from its direction and the Germano scale-similarity relation is never evaluated: the model has no dynamic content.
Homogeneous averaging is an unimplemented placeholder, so the coefficient is purely local and clipped to [0, max_cs].
The i/j/k homogeneous-filter options are parsed but inert while that placeholder stands.

evidence.note: Confirmed by reading the implementation. Not re-derived against Germano (1991) / Lilly (1992) line by line; that belongs to the scientific audit.

records.rationale: Unlike the dynamic model there is no imminent fix, and the failure is silent: a run reports LES enabled while applying no subgrid dissipation. Disclosure is therefore published immediately rather than scoped.
defect_summary: FlowSolver calls ComputeSmagorinskyConstant only when step == StartStep + 1 (src/solvers.c).
On a fresh run StartStep == 0, so the only call is at step 1.
ComputeSmagorinskyConstant returns early with VecSet(CS, 0.0) when step < 2 && StartStep == 0 (src/les.c).
For the constant model the function is never called again, so CS remains 0 for the whole run.
tests/c/test_runtime_kernels.c invokes the helper directly at step 2, bypassing the lifecycle, so the defect is not covered.

evidence.note: Confirmed by reading the call path. Not confirmed by an end-to-end run producing zero eddy viscosity; doing so would establish it empirically.

records.resolution: Runtime fix required in the FlowSolver/ComputeSmagorinskyConstant lifecycle, plus a test that drives the real loop from a fresh start. Explicitly out of scope for the documentation overhaul.
